gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participant with new diagnosis of GBM according to World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 Classification.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Treatment Group:  (interventions: Device: Optune® device; Drug: Temozolomide; Drug: Pembrolizumab)
Pembrolizumab (other names: KEYTRUDA®): Pembrolizumab dose throughout this study is 200 mg IV Q3W for a maximum of 35 cycles.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have completed standard adjuvant chemoradiotherapy of radiotherapy (RT) according to local practice (56-64 Gy), and concomitant TMZ chemotherapy.
Phase 3 Study of Optune Concomitant With Temozolomide Plus Pembrolizumab in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

coder_notes: Placebo (saline) is a registered intervention in the Control Group but has no active moiety; not listed as an agent. Optune TTFields device given in both arms; it does not deliver or activate pembrolizumab, so device_dependent false. Setting is maintenance after completed chemoradiation (newly diagnosed).
